title: ScoringDiscrepNBA — NBA Scoring-Discrepancy Monitor
description: NBA scoring-discrepancy database and monitoring system with a Pages site, alerting documentation and a repository review. Its README records a preservation limitation — the compact investigation ledger keeps the first three and latest twenty observations rather than every intermediate observation or original HTTP body — and states that full immutable evidence storage remains a requirement rather than a completed feature. It also reports 100 passing tests in the integrated active suite and warns that neither a successful deployment nor a passing suite proves live notification delivery or complete source coverage.
